source.prompt: best ERP software for small manufacturing business under 50 employees
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
For small manufacturing businesses with fewer than 50 employees, ERP software like Odoo, ERPNext, Cetec ERP, and NetSuite ERP offer affordability, scalability, and manufacturing-focused features suitable for SMB operations.
Key Considerations for SMB Manufacturing ERP
Ease of implementation: Small teams require ERP systems that can go live quickly, typically within 1–3 months, without heavy IT support 1.
Core modules: Prioritize finance, inventory, and CRM first, then expand to production planning, work order management, and reporting 1.
Deployment: Cloud-based solutions are generally preferred for small manufacturers due to lower upfront costs and simpler maintenance 1.
Scalability and cost: Pay attention to per-user pricing, subscription models, and options for small teams to avoid cost spikes as the business grows 1.
Recommended ERP Software for Small Manufacturing Businesses
Odoo
Best for: Small to mid-sized manufacturers seeking a modular, open-source ERP that can grow with operations.
Features: Pre-built apps for manufacturing, CRM, HR, inventory; low-code/no-code customization; third-party marketplace; strong community support 1.
Pricing: $25–30/user/month (Standard plan, billed annually), with a free community edition.
Deployment: Cloud or on-premise 1.
ERPNext
Best for: SMBs needing open-source, fully customizable ERP.
Features: Auto-sync across modules, manufacturing/production management, self-hosted or cloud, real-time dashboards 2.
Pricing: Free self-hosted; cloud-hosted subscriptions start around $50/month.
Cetec ERP
Best for: Small job shops or contract manufacturers who need cost-effective cloud ERP.
Features: Comprehensive all-in-one platform including CRM, inventory, manufacturing quoting, QA, lot tracking, and mobile access without additional module costs 2.
Pricing: Approximately $40/user/month.
Deployment: Cloud-based, no implementation fee.
NetSuite ERP
Best for: Small manufacturers aiming for enterprise-grade capabilities with scalable growth.
Features: Integrated financial management, CRM, supply chain, inventory, and real-time analytics. Cloud-based with dashboards and business intelligence tools 1.
Pricing: Varies; generally higher than alternatives but robust for SMB growth.
Digit
Best for: SMBs requiring real-time MRP, inventory, and shop-floor traceability quickly.
Features: Cloud-based with inventory, production, purchasing, and order management in one platform; integrates with QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon 2.
Pricing: Starting at $400/month; fast implementation (2–6 weeks).
SAP Business One
Best for: SMBs seeking proven ERP reliability with a broad feature set.
Features: Modular ERP covering finance, inventory, production, CRM; on-premise or cloud; strong support ecosystem 1.
Pricing: Around $95/user/month, with total cost $50K–$250K depending on scope.
Summary Recommendation
For small manufacturing operations under 50 employees, open-source or cloud-first solutions like Odoo, ERPNext, and Cetec ERP are ideal for affordability and scalability. If your business anticipates fast growth or desires enterprise-level analytics and integration, NetSuite ERP or SAP Business One can provide advanced capabilities at higher cost. Digit is notable for rapid deployment and real-time shop-floor visibility. Start with core modules (finance, inventory, CRM) and expand ERP functionalities as your manufacturing needs evolve top10erp.org+2.
